DTC P1725 NT Revolution Sensor Circuit Malfunction
(Input Turbine Speed Sensor)
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
This sensor detects the rotation speed of the input turbine. By comparing the input turbine speed signal (NT)
and the counter gear speed sensor signal (NC), the ECM detects the shift timing of the gears and appropri­
ately controls the engine torque and hydraulic pressure in response to various conditions, thus performing
smooth gear shifting.
